items.title: What energy-sector expertise can bring to Europe’s emerging carbon removal industry
items.summary: Stockholm Exergi publishes an interview with Carlo Sem, Project Director at Saipem, about the construction of Beccs Stockholm. It covers how energy-sector expertise is being applied to building the bio-CCS plant.
items.why_it_matters: Beccs Stockholm is a key Swedish capture node whose build-out timing drives future CO2 shipping volumes from Stockholm to North Sea storage.

items.title: Norway consolidating lead role for CO₂ storage
items.summary: The article reports that Yinson's Havstjerne CO2 storage project has signed a collaboration agreement with EcoLog, linking EcoLog's dual-purpose terminal in Amsterdam for CO2 storage to Havstjerne's offshore permanent storage and injection on the Norwegian shelf.
items.why_it_matters: A continental terminal-to-Norwegian-storage link adds a new ship-based chain option and intermediate storage hub for cross-border CO2 network models.
